data.voice_note: Voces: Oliver (contando el sueño) y Maya (tomando notas científicas).
data.script: Oliver: In my dream, our spaceship was yellow, like a banana! … Maya: A banana spaceship. Noted. Where did you land? … Oliver: On a purple planet with three moons in the sky. … Maya: Three moons! And the aliens? … Oliver: They were small and green, with four ears each. Very friendly! … Maya: What did they give you? … Oliver: A concert! They played music on glass drums. … Oliver: And the rivers, Maya… the rivers were made of lemonade. I drank from one! … Maya: What a strange and delicious planet!

data.script: Listen and match each person to a picture. There is one example. … Diego: Oliver, which picture did you choose? … Oliver: I chose the earth. … Diego: Maya, which picture did you choose? … Maya: I chose the alien. … Diego: Bruno, which picture did you choose? … Bruno: I chose the astronaut. … Diego: Iris, which picture did you choose? … Iris: I chose the spaceship. … Diego: Samu, which picture did you choose? … Samu: I chose the space.
